title: Temporary Transfer of Funds - Up To $30 Million - Fiscal Year 2019-2020 - County of Alameda Treasury - Chief Financial Officer
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 1920-0002 - Requesting Temporary Transfer of Funds In An Amount Not To Exceed $30 Million Dollars From The Alameda County Treasury Due To Fluctuation In District Revenue And Receipts For Fiscal Year 2019-2020.
headline: Allows temporary borrowing of up to $30M from the Alameda County Treasury in 2019-20
summary: The Board adopts a resolution asking the Alameda County Treasury for a temporary transfer of funds of no more than $30 million. The text says this is because district revenue and receipts fluctuate during fiscal year 2019-2020. The text does not say how or when the funds would be repaid.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Fourth Amendment, Office Lease - Sparknight, LLC - Central Administrative Offices - 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of the Fourth Amendment, Office Lease between the Oakland Unified School District (“District”), as Lessee, and Sparknight, LLC, a Florida limited liability company, as Lessor (“Lessor”), for space within the building located at 1000 Broadway, Oakland, California 94607, commonly known as the TransPacific Centre (the “Property”), for square footage described in Section 4.1 of the Fourth Amendment, for the monthly base rent, described in Section 4.2, of the Fourth Amendment, as follows:
•     $236, 304.80 (monthly) from September 1, 2019 through August 31, 2020;
•     $243,393.94 (monthly) from September 1, 2020 through August 31, 2021; and
•     $250, 695.76 (monthly) from September 1, 2021 through August 31, 2022,
plus, the pro-rata shares of increases to taxes and operating expenses beginning on January 1, 2020, as stated in Sections 4.3 (a) and 4.3(b) of the Fourth Amendment. All other terms and conditions, except those modified by this Amendment and/or prior amendments, remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Sets rent for the district's 1000 Broadway offices at about $236K to $251K a month through 2022
summary: This fourth amendment to the office lease with Sparknight, LLC sets monthly base rent for the central administrative offices at 1000 Broadway. Rent is $236,304.80 a month from September 2019, $243,393.94 from September 2020 and $250,695.76 from September 2021, through August 31, 2022. The district also pays its share of increases in taxes and operating expenses starting January 1, 2020. The text does not state a total.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

title: Memorandum of Understanding and Agreement - District and Saint Mary's College of California - Talent/Human Resources Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Memorandum of Understanding and Agreement between the District and Saint Mary’s College of California (College or SMC), a California nonprofit public benefit corporation, Moraga, CA, for the latter to provide an Intern Partnership Program; Student Teaching Practica; School Counselor, Clinical Educational Therapist, Clinical School Psychologist and Administrative Internships; and Practica and Immersive Experience for Pre-Credential Candidate Undergraduate Students, as specified, for the period of July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022, at no cost to the District.

It also covers practica and immersive experiences for undergraduates working toward a credential. It runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022 at no cost to the district.
